description: This file defines a React component 'MindmapCanvas' that renders an interactive mind map diagram using SVG. It includes layout computation, node rendering with various styles based on node types, and supports zooming, panning, and node selection. The code handles complex layout logic for positioning nodes and edges to match a specific visual style, including clusters, callouts, and sub-branches, as well as user interaction features like zoom and drag.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between specified min and max values.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, defaulting to empty if null or undefined.

methods.name: numberOrNull
methods.description: Parses an unknown value into a finite number or null if invalid.

methods.name: extractPercentRange
methods.description: Attempts to extract a percentage range from a node's properties or title.

methods.name: isLikelyStepNode
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a node is a 'step' in the mind map.

methods.name: computeLevels
methods.description: Calculates hierarchical levels of nodes based on edges and a center node.

methods.name: nodeLane
methods.description: Determines the layout lane for a node based on its properties and context.

methods.name: buildAdjacency
methods.description: Builds adjacency maps ('out' and 'inn') from edges for graph traversal.

methods.name: chooseRightPrimary
methods.description: Selects the primary node on the right side based on levels.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Main function that computes the positions and connections of nodes for rendering, matching design layout.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps text labels into multiple lines based on max characters per line and max lines.

methods.name: MindmapCanvas
methods.description: React component rendering an interactive, zoomable SVG mind map with custom layout and node styling.
